payload.question: You received an email asking you to re-authenticate your Microsoft 365 account. Which element in this email screenshot is the biggest red flag?
options: The 'Verify Now' button links to 'microsoftonline-auth.com' not 'microsoft.com'
The email says your session expired 2 hours ago
The Microsoft logo appears in the email header
The email was sent at 2:47 AM
payload.anomaly_hint: Hover over the action button to see where it actually points

explanation: Microsoft's authentication domain is 'login.microsoftonline.com' — not 'microsoftonline-auth.com'. The hyphen + 'auth' is a registrant trick to look official. Session expiry notices, logos, and off-hours sends are all distractors. The destination URL of any call-to-action button is the most reliable indicator of phishing.
